messages:
Maya (oncall): paging in — 503 spike across svc-payment and svc-billing, customers seeing checkout failures. alert window ~18:12-18:24 UTC. paging channel got noisy. can we lock down handoff and post-incident next steps? :alarm_clock:
incident-bot: Pager: PAYMENT-503-high triggered -> routed to maya. Incident created: INC-2028. Severity: Sev2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2028 :pager:
Sam W: on it. quick mitigation: disable new payment attempts (feature-flag), roll back last deploy? any deploys at 18:10? :eyes:
Leo K: I see a suspicious spike in db connections on db-payments at 18:09. not a deploy. looks like backlog on a query introduced by recent index change. digging.
Tess R: Maya — can you hand off to Sam for the rest of the on-call window? I'm on next rotation in 30m. would like a clear postmortem owner.
Maya (oncall): handing to Sam now. Sam, please mark postmortem owner if we need one. also flag customer-impact and whether any outages to enterprise customers.
Sam W: taking over. I disabled `checkout-enable-new` flag at 18:15 which reduced errors; traffic normalized by 18:22. I also opened an incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/INC-2028 (putting timeline + logs).
Priya N: customer-impact: noticed errors hitting a subset of EU customers (acct IDs start with EU-). CS reported 4 enterprise customers with failed checkouts during window. escalating to account leads.
Leo K: root cause draft: a poorly constrained JOIN in order-reconciliation query hit table scan after index changes, caused DB connection pool exhaustion -> 503s. Working on fix to rewrite query and add circuit breaker in svc-payment.
Tess R: suggested post-incident tasks: 1) fix query + deploy 2) add DB circuit breaker 3) update runbooks for index changes 4) alert when connection pool > 70% for > 2m 5) customer outreach template. we should track these in actionboard.
Sam W: agree. also add 'verify no deploys caused this' as an action. assigning owners below.
Maya (oncall): quick note for process improvement: our current postmortem creation is manual. proposal: auto-generate postmortem draft when an incident has >5min customer-impact or >3 enterprise customers affected. include timeline skeleton, attach logs, and assign a PM to coordinate.
Leo K: +1. can we also auto-parse the thread to surface candidate action items and owners (regex for "assign to @name" or lines starting with "TODO:")? would save manual triage.
Tess R: extra idea: have actionboard-bot create a linked board row and populate fields: title (INC id), severity, impact, owner, due date default = incident + 7d, status=open. then auto-post a checklist in thread with links.
actionboard-bot: Draft action row created for INC-2028 -> https://actionboard.redwood/rows/INC-2028. Fields populated: severity=Sev2, owner=Sam W, due=2028-05-09. Use `/actionboard update` to modify.
Priya N: for compliance, the postmortem must include customer-impact and distribution list. Can the auto-draft include a stubbed outreach note and a TOC for CS/Legal?
Sam W: yes. template fields: impact_summary, timeline, root_cause, actions, mitigation, customer_communications. propose adding a new required field: "verification plan" so owners must close with evidence.
Maya (oncall): Here's a quick config sketch for an "incident-scribe" micro-bot that does auto-drafts and action extraction. feedback welcome:

incident-scribe:
  trigger:
    - incident.severity >= 2
    - incident.customer_impacted == true
  actions:
    - create_doc: /incidents/{{id}}/postmortem-draft
    - extract_actions: regex_lines(["TODO:","Assign:","Owner:"])
    - create_actionboard_row: title={{id}} owner={{oncall}} due=+7d
    - notify: channel=eng-oncall text="Postmortem draft created"

Tess R: nice. also add `canary: true` so we can run this for lab incidents first. and a toggle to disable auto-create for P0 during hotfix-only windows.
Leo K: we should capture the handoff itself in the postmortem metadata (who handed off, at what ts). saves confusion. maybe incident-bot can append a small Handoff section when a `/handoff to @name` happens.
Maya (oncall): agreed. small UX ask: when actionboard-bot creates rows, please include an easy `/claim` button in-thread that pings the assignee and sets owner. reduces friction.
actionboard-bot: Feature note acknowledged. We'll prototype `/claim` which posts an interactive button and sets owner on click.
Priya N: timeline & next steps: Sam to ship query fix by EOD tomorrow, Leo to add circuit breaker + test, Tess to draft CS outreach template, Maya to file FR for postmortem automation and schedule a 30-min sync with SRE + DevEx.
Sam W: actions (quick):
- Fix query (owner: Sam W) due: 2028-05-03
- Add DB circuit breaker (owner: Leo K) due: 2028-05-04
- Add alerting (owner: Tess R) due: 2028-05-05
- Postmortem draft (owner: Sam W) due: 2028-05-06
- Customer outreach (owner: Tess R / Priya N) due: 2028-05-03
Please confirm owners in thread.
Leo K: confirmed for circuit breaker.
Tess R: confirmed for alerting and outreach draft.
Maya (oncall): I'll file FR for automation and include config sketch. assigning FR owner: Maya (oncall) due 2028-05-10.
Sam W: I'll mark postmortem owner in doc and set actionboard rows. linking here when done.
Maya (oncall): final note — for the postmortem template, require a short TL;DR (1-2 lines) for execs. long-form can go in body. Also add a quick "How we verified it won't happen again" section for closure. :memo:
Tess R: thanks all. follow-ups in actionboard.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2028 marked Resolved at 18:24 UTC. Resolution summary: feature-flag rollback + DB query mitigation.
Maya (oncall): marking channel resolved. will re-open if new info.
